domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least/common denominator (or use a given one) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly determines an LCD/LCM or states a chosen common denominator for unlike denominators
Rewrites one or both fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) as equivalent fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work proceeds directly to subtraction
Only rewrites/borrows from a whole number as d/d to support regrouping (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Compute the difference once parts are aligned by subtracting numerators over a common denominator (including as the fractional-part step within mixed-number subtraction).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator
Subtracts the fractional parts of mixed numbers after denominators match (may yield 0 or a negative fraction)
Performs the core subtraction after converting to a common-denominator form (including improper-fraction workflows)
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD or rewrites fractions without performing the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces or converts the final result without doing the subtraction operation

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Regroup whole and fractional parts (including borrowing 1 from the whole and adding an equivalent d/d to the fraction part or rewriting a whole as a mixed number) to enable valid subtraction and then recombine.
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole part because the fractional subtraction would be negative, then adds an equivalent 1 = d/d to the fractional part
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a zero or full fractional part to set up subtraction (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5; 2 as 1 3/3)
Recombines whole and fractional parts after regrouping/borrowing
exclusion_criteria: Pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number component and no borrowing/regrouping
Only converts between mixed and improper fractions as a final formatting step (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer in an appropriate form (integer, proper/improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 2/10 → 1/5; 9/12 → 3/4)
Simplifies a zero fraction to 0 or otherwise recognizes an integer result
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or otherwise formats the final result for the response)
exclusion_criteria: Only performs common-denominator conversion, subtraction, or regrouping without any reduction/formatting of the result
Intermediate rewriting done solely to enable borrowing/regrouping (tag S03 instead)
